items.proposed: 1p/19q codeletion (oligodendroglioma): CNS5-defining exclusion, exempt from any_molecular_selection; candidate_matched false
items.reason: 'Patients with oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted are not eligible' is a diagnostic exclusion exempt under D31-A5; selection outcomes are set by the IDH1-mutation requirement matched to olutasidenib.

note: Trial fails S5 (IDH1-mutant tumours only; arm labels 'IDH 1 mutant Astrocytoma'), so selection outcomes do not affect inclusion. cns5_terminology (priority 3) set to unclear: 'CNS WHO Grade' notation but no explicit WHO 2021 citation or IDH-wildtype requirement.

revisions.from: 1p/19q codeletion: eligibility (exclusion), candidate_matched false; no effect on outcomes
revisions.to: 1p/19q codeletion (oligodendroglioma): CNS5-defining exclusion, exempt from any_molecular_selection; candidate_matched false
revisions.reason: The exclusion of 'oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted' only defines the tumour type and is exempt from any_molecular_selection.
The record says 'pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties of olutasidenib will also be assessed' but registers only plasma PK outcomes and describes no PD measurement.
